hook: Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including your competitors.
caption:
Your AI gives everyone the same answer. Including your competitors.

Here's what most people miss: ChatGPT doesn't know if you're a big-picture visionary who hates being micromanaged with bullet points — or a detail-obsessed operator who needs every step spelled out.

So it guesses. And it guesses... average.

The person who thinks in frameworks gets the same response as the person who thinks in stories. The person who needs brutal honesty gets the same soft, hedged answer as the person who needs gentle encouragement.

Average output for everyone. Congratulations, we're all equally underwhelmed.

This is the actual problem with AI right now — not that it's too dumb, but that it doesn't know YOU. It knows language. It doesn't know how your brain works, what you've already tried, or that you'd rather get one sharp insight than five mediocre ones.

BootFile fixes this by building a profile of how YOU think — your reasoning style, your blind spots, your communication preferences — and loading that context every single time.

Same AI. Completely different results.

Because the gap between a generic AI response and a calibrated one isn't the model. It's the context.
